errors.text: The hypothesis predicts a BCC-dominant or single-BCC product, whereas the target result is an FCC-dominant dual-phase structure containing approximately 83% FCC and 17% BCC.

The stated VEC < 6.87 premise is inconsistent with nominally equimolar CoCrFeNiTi, whose simple elemental-average VEC is approximately 7.4; this undermines the claimed thermodynamic direction of the FCC-to-BCC transition.
Low-load HV0.1 testing does not by itself isolate Hall-Petch strengthening from precipitation hardening, and very low loads can increase rather than minimize indentation-size effects.
The cited evidence is generic HEA literature and does not substantiate the alloy-specific phase transition, HCP threshold, SPS boundary, or numerical VEC claim.
